title: Zoning text change to require affordable units at 100-12 Queens Boulevard
summary: This action would designate a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 100-12 Queens Boulevard in Forest Hills, Queens, working alongside a related zoning map change. Together the actions would enable a 21-story building with about 389 apartments, including 97 income-restricted units, and 16,000 square feet of commercial space. The Council's Land Use Committee recommended approval with modifications on November 10, 2026.
